title: Locally closed comparison coordinates
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A and a closed immersion c:S→V followed by an open immersion v:V→T, the comparison coordinates are the two ordinary derived closed right adjoints together with their actual adjunctions; the composites J_et=v_et^* Rc_et^! and J_proet=v_proet^* Rc_proet^! use the pasted adjunctions. Write F_et=v_et,! Rc_et,* and F_proet=v_proet,! Rc_proet,*. Delta is the named closed direct-image counit mate followed by the canonical open extension comparison on bounded-below complexes. For an immersion s, use its scheme-theoretic image compactification and the unique identity-on-source etale extension comparison to identify F_et with closure compact support and J_et with its exceptional right adjoint. These are the existing constructions of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], [lem-exc-closed-ambient] and [lem-sfb-etale-locally-closed-extension-comparison], relocated without changing their types or bodies.
